assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied painted DropShip office. Preserve the original 1672:940 composition and all existing object positions exactly: wall chart and its blank opening, calendar and blank display/post-it, safe and blank balance display, chair, desk, mug, papers, filing cabinet, lamp and CRT. Change ONLY two places. (1) Replace the dark starfield visible inside the right porthole glass with a view into an enclosed industrial BattleMech repair hangar: distant olive steel maintenance gantries, amber work lights and a suggestion of a very large robot leg. Keep the circular porthole rim unchanged, with no outer space visible. (2) Add a small physical retro rolodex on the desk just left of the metal mug, above the closed leather folio, approximately original coordinates x670..820 y565..640. A rotating index-card file in worn dark olive metal with ivory cards, a small BLANK front counter plaque for live game text. Do not obscure safe or chair. Match the detailed hand-painted amber/olive retro futuristic industrial style. No readable text, no numbers, no UI, no logos or watermark. All other objects and display openings must remain in the same places.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished wide 16:9 background for a desktop BattleTech mercenary strategy game. An EMPTY BattleMech maintenance bay inside an old DropShip in 3025. Rich detailed hand-painted concept art, worn olive steel bulkheads, brass and amber lamps, warm work lights against cool green shadows, matching a battered captain's office. Wide symmetrical eye-level view. A central circular maintenance platform occupies the lower middle with an EMPTY tall center for a separate robot illustration. Maintenance gantries, heavy cables and crane arms at sides, striped safety floor, high ribbed ceiling. Left and right edges quiet and dark for interface panels. No BattleMech, no people, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Grounded industrial retro-futurist atmosphere. Final landscape 1792x1024.
